lines.2: Day two of coming to school during the break.
lines.3: It looked like it was going to get seriously hot.
lines.6: Konoe was standing frozen in front of the school gate.
lines.8: 「It's strange... Look at the iron gate.」
lines.10: The iron gate still looked like it needed plenty more cleaning.
lines.11: 「If you don't get it properly clean, it'll probably fail inspection.」
lines.12: 「I worked hard cleaning it last night.」
lines.13: 「And it's this dirty again... Something's wrong.」
lines.15: 「My eyesight's good, and I'm meticulous even by my own standards. No way.」
lines.16: 「But this is what it looks like...」
lines.17: 「More than dirt... what stands out is how many places the paint's starting to peel. Here and there.」
lines.18: 「Exactly. You can really see it, can't you?」
lines.19: 「It's seriously strange. It's worse than it was yesterday.」
lines.20: 「Damn it... Guess I'll just have to work at it again tonight.」
lines.21: Konoe muttered that under her breath.
